SIM.08 — Simulation credibility tests
Design: Distinguish program verification, fit/calibration, external validation and context of use

== SIM.08 Simulation credibility tests ==
Intent: Distinguish program verification, fit/calibration, external validation and context of use 
Test: Report independent synthetic and real-case metrics
 BOOK/LECTURE A09 Stan User’s Guide | Posterior and Prior Predictive Checks | https://mc-stan.org/docs/stan-users-guide/ppcs.html | verified section
 BOOK/LECTURE A15 FDA Computational Model Credibility Guidance | Context of use; model verification, validation and credibility assessment | https://www.fda.gov/regulatory-information/search-fda-guidance-documents/assessing-credibility-computational-modeling-and-simulation-medical-device-submissions | applicability limited to intended guidance scope
 PAPER P05 Breast MRI clinical trial image collections | https://www.cancerimagingarchive.net/collection/ispy2/

  Inspect: Inspect example models, diagnostics and posterior predictive workflows 
  Reuse: Adopt mathematical diagnostics methodology; runtime integration optional 
  Avoid: Do not label statistical checks as clinical validation 
  Verify: Seed reproducibility and simulated vs observed distribution checks
